title: Reef Quest: gentle-shell as a handheld game in the terminal
brief: gentle-shell in Ghostty (1920x920) as a GBA-style game in the Gentleman-Cute palette: the orchestrator (top hat with rose, fuchsia mustache, monocle) talks to the user in a Pokemon text box with its portrait; its thoughts are shown or hidden by the user's choice (alt+t); status becomes a Zelda HUD (coffee cups for context, gems for cost, model and profile as equipped B/A items, project and branch as the area name); subagents are party slots, the todo list is the current quest, tool calls are battle text, and a start menu (alt+m) holds journal, map (status), save (Engram) and options. The room is the real engine and reducer from web/, story camera at 2x.

artboards.title: Reef Quest
artboards.tradeoff: Most immersive: one game screen with the orchestrator speaking to you and status as HUD; the scrolling chat history moves to JOURNAL, so reading long tool output takes a menu step; scaled to fit any window

artboards.title: Gentle HQ (new scene)
artboards.tradeoff: A new office where every object is a gentle-shell feature, plus the live session around it: chat column, streaming thoughts (alt+t), notice toasts, a confirm dialog and a readable TODO; most complete, but the dialog covers the front of the room while it is open
